annotations.title: Look up an Indian food's nutrition

description: Get nutrition facts for ONE Indian food: calcium, fibre, iron, protein per 100 g and per katori/serving, each with the source article URL to cite. Covers 60 foods (dals, millets, paneer, soya, nuts, fruit and more) from ICMR-NIN composition tables. Use compare_foods for several foods at once, search_guides for topics rather than single foods. Read-only, no side effects; if the food is not covered it returns found=false with the list of available foods instead of an error.

food.description: One food name in English or common Hindi, e.g. 'rajma', 'moong dal', 'paneer', 'ragi'.

nutrient.description: Optional. Return only this nutrient; omit to get every nutrient available for the food.

name: lookup_food
